Author: Serpens66
Name: Serps Mods - Fully Customizable Collection
Description:
All included mods can be freely configured in the in-game Mod Settings.

Included mods:
- Bugfixes and QoL
- Building Costs
- Building Limit
- Extra Features
- Random Events
- CastlePlanner
- Start Conditions
- Unit Costs
- Unit Limit

Changes: Separated validated APIShared infrastructure from activatable mods in the Workshop manifest.
Preserves the static lobby inventory publisher for the full process lifetime.
Added a Mod Settings notice explaining how to enable mods for trails, Sand of Time, and campaigns.
Fixed the host package manifest version mismatch.
Updated the mod for Script Extender 2.2.0.
Updated unified Steam Workshop package contents.
Ignore the Script Extender's known 1.0.0 placeholder when resolving its installed version and warn on genuinely conflicting version evidence.
Check the installed Script Extender version against the supported range declared in info.json and show a prominent Mod Settings warning when it is incompatible.
Add the global Mod Settings search with mod and tooltip filters plus safe handoff to supported local setting and section filters.
Updated unified Steam Workshop package contents.
Warns in lobby chat when a joining player's Script Extender mod hash differs from the host.
Explicitly opts the diagnostic host settings out of CustomCustomTrail discovery.
Initial unified Steam Workshop mod-pack host.
